claims.text: Zhan Liang serves Cantonese, Sichuanese and Northern Chinese dishes and has a tea library and a signature roasting station.

findings.quote: Zhan Liang is a Chinese restaurant in Phnom Penh with bold Cantonese, Sichuanese, and Northern dishes, a tea library and signature roasting station, crafted for culinary discovery.

claims.text: Brasserie Louis pairs views with French comfort food and Cambodian favorites made with local ingredients.

findings.quote: Brasserie Louis pairs stunning views with French comfort food and Cambodian favorites, made with the finest local ingredients in the heart of Phnom Penh.

claims.text: The Whisky Library is a cigar and whisky lounge offering rare single malts, 24 cigar varieties and skyline views.

findings.quote: Cigar and Whisky Lounge
Discover the city’s finest whisky library and cigar lounge, offering rare single malts, 24 cigar varieties, and a cozy, elegant space with skyline views.

claims.text: Living Room is an all-day lounge for artisan coffee, cakes and evening drinks.

findings.quote: Artful All-Day Lounge
Living Room makes it the perfect venue to stop by for artisan coffee, cakes and sweet confections or a glass of your favorite evening tipple.

claims.text: The hotel's curated art collection connects guests to the traditions of Cambodia.

findings.quote: The hotel’s curated art collection connects guests to the charm, spirit, and traditions of Cambodia through the lens of a living, evolving canvas.

claims.text: Premier River Rooms have Tonle Sap views, custom art, a marble bath and a walk-in shower.

findings.quote: Premier River Rooms boast fabled Tonle Sap views and chic 50 square meters living space. A refined, residential feel with custom art, marble bath, and walk-in shower

claims.text: Mekong Suites have a king bed, a living room and views of the Mekong River.

findings.quote: Mekong Suites offer private, residential-style comfort with a king bed, spacious living room, and stunning views of the legendary Mekong River.

claims.text: The Norodom House has a grand foyer, a sitting room, a bedroom with a dressing chamber, a private study and a dining room.

findings.quote: The 225 square meters Norodom House offers refined living with a grand foyer, airy sitting room, elegant bedroom with dressing chamber, private study, and chic dining room.

claims.text: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers treatments inspired by traditional healing herbs and techniques.

findings.quote: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers a treatment series inspired by traditional healing herbs and techniques to restore and revitalize the body and mind.

claims.text: A Khmer architectural tour explores Phnom Penh's 1960s heritage buildings aboard a traditional remork.

findings.quote: Khmer Achitectural Tour
Dive into Phnom Penh’s unique 60’s heritage and explore its landmark buildings aboard a traditional Remork.

claims.text: A self-guided tour through Phnom Penh's historic heart follows a quest for a lost Khmer antique and a mysterious French adventurer.

findings.quote: Step into the shoes of explorers on a quest for a lost Khmer antique and a mysterious French adventurer in this unique self-guided tour through Phnom Penh’s historic heart.

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants and lounges have bird's-eye views from Cambodia's tallest skyscraper.

findings.quote: Rosewood Phnom Penh’s restaurants and lounges captivate with bold cuisine, distinct concepts, and stunning bird’s-eye views from Cambodia’s tallest skyscraper.

claims.text: A hydroponic garden on Level 9 supplies all of the hotel's greens.

findings.quote: our hydroponic garden on Level 9 supplies 100% of the hotel's greens - harvested and on the plate within hours

claims.text: Sora received the Ketel One Sustainable Bar Award 2025 for eco-mixology practices including zero-waste ingredients, local vermouth and in-house kombucha infusions.

findings.quote: Sora receives the Ketel One Sustainable Bar Award 2025 for pioneering eco-mixology practices—from zero-waste ingredients to local vermouth and in-house kombucha infusions.

claims.text: CUTS is a steakhouse with hand-cut meats, a signature grill room, private suites and a wine cellar with over 3,000 bottles.

findings.quote: CUTS is an award-winning steakhouse in Phnom Penh, known for hand-cut meats, a signature grill room, private suites and a curated wine cellar with over 3,000 wine bottles.

claims.text: Iza brings the spirit of a Japanese izakaya, with a robata-yaki grill, sushi counter, noodle corner and a curated selection of sake.

findings.quote: Iza brings the spirit of a Japanese izakaya to Phnom Penh, with a robata-yaki grill, sushi counter and noodle corner, as well as a curated selection of sake.

claims.text: The hotel's restaurants and lounges sit high up in Cambodia's tallest skyscraper, so this is a high-rise city stay.

findings.quote: stunning bird’s-eye views from Cambodia’s tallest skyscraper
A skyscraper hotel never looked so chic.
Situated in an upmarket business district within the Vattanac Capital Tower

claims.text: WhataHotel notes a modern high-rise setting rather than traditional Cambodian architecture.
